source: docs/specs/m1-step5d-clock-fixes.md, Pre-registered checks, with the lead's Resolved 1 (2026-11-13): d.kneel.thenPlay.lead9 is reported only, not gated
note: Pre-registered before any M1 step 5d measure code or sim run. Never edited after its sha256 is recorded in DECISIONS.md.
noteOnOrder: Unlike 5c, the playtest and the diagnosis measured some real values before these thresholds were written (23.1%, 69.5%, 0.075). Each tolerance below is set from the sampling noise of the real count and the sim's 10,000 games, not from where the sim is expected to land.
definitions: Same on both sides (a pipeline module for real 2016-2023 regular season, 2,095 games, and a script for the sim's in-sample run): "per game" is per game, not per team-game. "Gap" is as in `c.trail.longGap`: game seconds between two consecutive scrimmage snaps of one drive with no timeout, two-minute warning or period end between them. "Clock running" at a snap is the `clockRunning` field of milestone A. Leading, trailing and tied are the offense's score at the snap. In overtime, "left" means left in the period.

checks.measure: Q4 and OT spikes by an offense trailing by 1-8 with 0 timeouts, per game
checks.whyTolerance: About 2 combined standard errors (real about 157 spikes, SE 0.006; sim SE 0.003); 20% of real

checks.measure: Q4 final 2:00 and OT, offense trailing by 1-8 with 0 timeouts, downs 1-3, clock running: spike share of snaps
checks.whyTolerance: About 2.5 SE at the expected real n of 400-600 snaps
checks.reference: real 69.5% (114/164) on 1st down in the final 0:40

checks.measure: Same states, clock stopped: spike share of snaps
checks.whyTolerance: Real is near 0; one-sided guard that the new level doesn't reopen stopped-clock spikes
checks.reference: real 1 in 242 on 1st down in the final 0:40

checks.measure: Q4 final 1:00, offense trailing by 1-8 with 0 timeouts: share of gaps of 15 s or more
checks.whyTolerance: About 2 combined SE (real n 844, SE 1.45 pp; sim SE about 0.9 pp)

checks.measure: Q4 and OT kneels by an offense trailing or tied with more than 0:47 left, per game
checks.whyTolerance: About 2.5 SE of a real count near 20; two-sided, because some real trailer kneels (down 1-2 in the red zone) are real choices

checks.measure: Q4 and OT possessions where an offense leading by 1-8 kneels and later on the same possession snaps a run or pass, per game
checks.whyTolerance: About 2.5 SE of a real count of 8

checks.passRule: reported only, not gated (lead, Resolved 1, 2026-11-13). The spec table's rule, abs(sim - real) <= 0.004, is not applied. These leaders are behind the accepted c.kneel.ballBack miss, which 5d does not target; c.kneel.ballBack must stay at or better than 8.97%.

checks.whyTolerance: Real count 0; allows about 20 cases in 10,000 games

checks.measure: Q4 and OT kneels on 4th down with more than 10 s left, per game
checks.whyTolerance: About 2 SE of a real count of 16

checks.measure: Overtime tries with the score -2 after the touchdown and `otBothPossessed` 1: two-point share. Sim side: the in-sample run's OT games plus league 4242 postseason seeds 1-10,000
checks.passRule: every such sim try is a two-point try; n reported on both sides
checks.whyTolerance: Designed rule (milestone E), real count expected near 0; the rule is binary, so no tolerance

noRegression5c.rule: The 14 checks that pass at run H still pass; c.kneel.ballBack (8.97%), c.fg.63 (0.0254) and c.fg.50to59 (0.764) stay at or better than their run H values.

reportedNotGated: Reported, not gated: d.kneel.thenPlay.lead9 (Resolved 1); spikes per game, all periods (real 0.262); spikes by 1-8 trailers holding 1+ timeouts; `d.gap.trail0TO` over the final 2:00; `d.kneel.notLeading` split into trailing 1-8, trailing 9+ and tied; real and sim n for every cell a new level fits; every `absMargin.share.*` bucket and the exact-3 share.
